verses.1: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ. Brother James also. To those who are beloved by God and who have been nourished by Jesus Christ.
verses.2: May mercy, peace, and love be abundant upon you.
verses.3: Beloved ones, with great care, I write to you about the necessity of writing to each other regarding our common salvation. I urge you to commit yourselves wholeheartedly to the faith that has been entrusted to the saints.
verses.4: Some people, who were destined from long ago to suffer this punishment, acted with disrespect, turning away from the grace of our God and denying our only Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.
verses.5: I want to remind you, knowing that you understand everything, that Jesus, after saving the people of Egypt from destruction, also saved those who did not believe.
verses.6: Those who did not follow their own principles were bound by strong bonds to be brought before a great judgment. They were punished for their actions.
verses.7: Just as Sodom and Gomorrah, along with the cities surrounding them, were destroyed in the same way, so too must those who act in such a manner be punished by eternal fire.
verses.8: Similarly, those who are in a state of sleep also destroy their own bodies. In fact, they truly do that; they also bring shame upon themselves.
verses.9: But Michael the archangel, when he was disputing with those who denied the body of Moses, did not dare to pronounce a judgment that would be considered blasphemous. Instead, he said, “You are unworthy, Lord.”
verses.10: And those who do not know what is considered insulting, and those who naturally feel offended by things that are unjust or unfair, they become angry as a result.
verses.11: They also lost their rights to travel along the road of Kain, and they were deprived of their wages from the land of Balam. They also lost their rights due to the disputes with Koré.
verses.12: These are those who remain hidden in your hearts, who dare to love you despite all obstacles. They’re like dry leaves carried away by the wind. They’re like fruits that die off in autumn.
verses.13: The wild waves of the sea exert their own strength upon everything around them; they’re like stars in the universe, whose darkness is turned into light by the force of the wind.
verses.14: And he also preached to them for seven days, starting from Adam Enoch. He said, “Look, a king has come with holy soldiers.”
verses.15: To judge everyone fairly and to condemn all those who are guilty of sinning against all those things that constitute sin. And to address all those harsh words that the wicked sinners have spoken against them.
verses.16: These are people who are led by their desires, who act according to those desires. Their mouths speak loudly, and they admire the faces of those who are kind and helpful.
verses.17: But you, beloved, remember the names of those who were warned by our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.18: For they said to you: In the future, they will be led by their own desires and act with impiety.
verses.19: These are those who are identified as being mental beings, having no soul.
verses.20: You also, beloved ones, as you build yourselves into the most holy faith among you, and in a holy spirit pray,
verses.21: Hold onto yourselves in the love of God, so that you may receive the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ for eternal life.
verses.22: And those who are distinguished from others.
verses.23: And those whom you save from the fire of destruction, and those whom you rescue from fear, despising even the fur that covers their bodies.
verses.24: But in order to keep you under control, and to make you obedient to his glory, he will surely do so.
verses.25: Only to the God of salvation can we hope for glory, greatness, and power throughout all ages, both now and forever. Amen.
